questions.text: What does a cryptographic hash function produce from an input?
questions.explanation: A hash maps arbitrary input to a fixed-length digest. A small input change should produce a very different digest.

questions.text: In a blockchain, what is a block primarily a record of?
questions.explanation: A block packages transactions with metadata such as a timestamp and a link to the prior block.

questions.text: Which key should you keep secret when using public-key cryptography?
questions.explanation: A private key authorizes signatures. A public key or address can be shared to receive funds.

questions.text: Why does each Bitcoin block include a hash of the previous block?
questions.explanation: The link creates an ordered chain: changing an earlier block changes its hash and breaks the following link.

questions.text: In Bitcoin, what is proof of work used for?
options: Selecting who proposes the next block
questions.explanation: Bitcoin miners compete to find a valid proof of work; the winning miner can propose the next block under the protocol rules.

questions.text: In Ethereum proof of stake, what does a validator risk when it violates protocol rules?
options: Its staked ETH can be slashed
questions.explanation: Ethereum proof of stake uses economic penalties, including slashing for some provable violations.

questions.text: What does a wallet's private key do in a typical blockchain transaction?
options: Stores all blocks on the network
questions.explanation: Wallet software uses the private key to create a digital signature. The network verifies the signature with the public key.

questions.text: What does a blockchain transaction nonce commonly help prevent?
questions.explanation: On Ethereum, an account nonce sequences transactions so an old signed transaction cannot normally be accepted again.

questions.text: What is a smart contract on Ethereum?
options: Program code executed by the network
A legal paper signed by a bank
questions.explanation: An Ethereum smart contract is code and persistent state at an address. Calls execute according to the Ethereum protocol.

questions.text: On Ethereum, what does gas measure?
questions.explanation: Gas measures execution work. A transaction fee is paid in ETH based on gas used and the chosen fee parameters.

questions.text: What is a key property of a confirmed blockchain transaction?
options: It is recorded according to the chain's consensus rules
It is automatically reversible by the sender
It is hidden from every node
questions.explanation: Confirmation means the transaction is included in the chain and accepted under that network's rules; it is not a chargeback promise.

questions.text: What is an Ethereum Layer 2 generally designed to do?
options: Process activity with security anchored to Ethereum
questions.explanation: Layer 2 systems execute transactions separately and use Ethereum for settlement or security, with details varying by design.

questions.text: Which action best protects a wallet's seed phrase?
options: Keep it offline and never share it
Paste it into a support chat
Store it in a public code repository
Send it to verify an airdrop
questions.explanation: Anyone with a seed phrase can usually control the wallet. Legitimate support will not need it.

questions.text: A website asks for your seed phrase to unlock a giveaway. What is this most likely?
questions.explanation: Seed phrases are recovery credentials, not proof of eligibility. A giveaway request for one is a strong phishing signal.

questions.text: Why should you verify a contract address before signing a token approval?
options: A malicious contract may spend approved tokens
The address determines your seed phrase
It guarantees a token will gain value
questions.explanation: An approval can authorize a contract to move specified tokens. Check the address and requested allowance before signing.

questions.text: What does a Merkle root summarize in many blockchain blocks?
questions.explanation: A Merkle tree combines transaction hashes into one root, allowing efficient proofs that a transaction belongs to the set.
